firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently saw a living sheep takes the cloth bag and spins the wheel first. The rules also allow the group to choose the bag holder randomly.
clarifications: In the standard placement phase, everyone selects and places landscape tiles simultaneously after the bag holder spins the wheel; the bag holder is an opening role, not the only player to place a tile.
The optional sequential placement variant starts with the bag holder and proceeds clockwise.
The cloth bag passes clockwise to the next player at the end of each round.

internalEvidence: Lookout Games' product page https://www.lookout-spiele.de/en/games/tipperary.html identifies the game and links an English PDF. Direct publisher download returned HTTP 403, so the publisher-authored English booklet was retrieved from the Spielezar mirror. Printed/PDF pages 2, 3, and 11 were rendered and visually checked. Mirror PDF SHA-256: 8114d18f5d3c174ea7304216399f7ec2acb946235c943fd6fe5387ef47e1a343. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The mirrored booklet was not byte-compared with the blocked publisher download; the publisher product page's indexed English text matches the reviewed rule.
The rules give random selection as an alternative and state no separate tie-break for equally recent sheep sightings.
